newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Yeltsin to set up page on Internet, Kremlin says.
newsitem.headline: Yeltsin to set up page on Internet, Kremlin says.

text.p: Russian President Boris Yeltsin is setting up his own home page on the Internet, the Kremlin said on Monday.
The page on the World Wide Web will give information about Yeltsin, his duties under the Russian constitution and related facts, a Kremlin spokesman said.
Many governments and leaders offer their own sites on the Internet worldwide network of computers, the most sophisticated of which feature audio and even video clips.

The Kremlin spokesman did not know the address of the new service, but a search of the Internet showed an official Russian administration site at www.maindir.gov.ru with information in both Russian and English, including a biography of Yeltsin.
